primary_source.name: Livshyts-Paouris-Pivovarov, On sharp bounds for marginal densities of product measures
primary_source.used_hypothesis: independent product coordinates, probability densities with L-infinity norm <=1

source_scope_check: Banks Theorem 4.15/Corollary 4.18 was rechecked but not extended through arbitrary same-side quadratic terms.

partner_result.application: Combined with the new one-sided Schur residual density estimate to obtain QFORM-ONE-SIDED-SCHUR-SMOOTHING-v1.

main_bound: For T=G(U)+2U^T B V+beta^T V, rank(B)>=2: ||p_T||_inf <= min_{2<=j<=rank B} j/(j-1) * (v_j/prod_{ell<=j} sigma_ell(B))^(1/j), with continuous density.
partner_applied_bound: After one physical pivot a and a Schur residual with S_JJ=0: ||p_Q||_inf <=2|a|^(-1/2) min_j sqrt(M_j); j=2 gives 2sqrt(2)pi^(1/4)/(|a|^(1/2)(sigma1 sigma2)^(1/4)).
continuity_status: proved for the one-sided cross theorem and direct physical-block corollary; not claimed for the dependent-square Schur wrapper
first_unproved_step: From only three eigenvalues |lambda|>=1, obtain a product-preserving decomposition entering either a ridge/diffuse branch or a quantitatively stable one-sided small-self-block cross branch.
next_step: Develop a perturbative extension of A_JJ=0 that pays a small same-side J block without falling into the corrected both-sides-uncontrolled cross-minor failure.
